RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the December 23, 2004/Pausa 2, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy; Coal;
Communications and Information Technology; External Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Mines; Ocean Development; Overseas Indian Affairs; Personnel,
Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Science and
Technology; Shipping, Road Transport and Highways;
Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions — 20
Constitution of Asian Economic
Community
*321. DR. AKHILESH DAS : Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have initiated
steps towards constitution of an Asian
Economic Community on the lines of
European Union (EU);
(b) if so, the precise constitution and
modus operandi of the contemplated
Economic Community and India's role
therein; and
(c) the progress made in this regard, so
far?
Funds for poverty eradication
*322. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether inadequate funds are
blocking developmental goals to reduce
poverty to half by the year 2015;
(b) whether the funds released by
Government are not reaching to the poor;
and
(c) if so, the action proposed to step up
efforts to remove economic hurdles, to
build up proper administration for
fulfilment of millenium goals to eradicate
poverty?
Security deposit in rural areas under
NOIDA Telephone Exchange
†*323. SHRI VEER SINGH: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that for
registration of telephone, a security amount
of Rs. 3000/- is being charged, instead of
Rs. 500/-, from the consumers of rural
categories coming under NOIDA
Telephone General Manager;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the details of the matter?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

97
Extradition treaty with Portugal
*324. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) Government efforts to tie a formal
extradition treaty with Portugal; and
(b) what efforts have been taken by
Government to ensure that more Indian
criminals in other countries like UAE,
Bangkok etc. are also handed over?
Jobs to unemployed youths
*325. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of educated unemployed
persons in the country, State-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
are forming a scheme for providing jobs to
unemployed educated youths in the
country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Single window facility for
NRIs
*326. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of OVERSEAS
INDIAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have planned
a comprehensive single window facility for
Non-Resident Indians and also special
courts and a 23 point programme that will
address pressing issues concerning the
NRIs;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) to what extent these proposals have
been finalized and announced; and
(d) to what extent Government have
been able to help the NRIs in a more
systematic manner?
Child labour in cotton seed
farms
*327. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether thousands of children are
working under hazardous conditions in the
cotton seed farms for various MNCs in
Andhra Pradesh;
(b) whether a number of children have
died or became seriously ill due to exposure
to pesticides;
(c) whether Government have issued
any instructions to these companies for
restricting them from hiring child
labourers; and
(d) the action taken by Government
against the cotton seed companies
employing child labourers?
Linking India, Myanmar and
Thailand by road
†*328. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
consideration of Government to link India,
Myanmar and Thailand by road routes;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when a final decision in this
regard would be taken?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

98
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Criteria for giving reservation to SC/
STs, and OBCs
*329. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the system adopted while giving
reservation to SC/STs and OBCs in Civil
Services and competitive examinations
held by UPSC, SSC, etc.;
(b) whether it is a fact that while
allocation is made to SC/STs and OBCs,
even meritorious reserved category
candidates are also included in it; and
(c) whether Government would change
this system of allocation for the benefit of
the SC/STs and the OBCs?
Upgradation of certain ESI hospitals in
Karnataka

MURTHY: Will the Minister

Total number of questions — 155
Promotion of coir industry
2210. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the steps Government have taken to
promote coir industry through Coir Board
in non-traditional zone;
(b) the steps taken to maximize husk
collection in non-traditional zone; and
(c) whether Government propose to
merge Coconut Development Board and
Coir Board to maximize husk collection in
general and non-traditional zone in
particular?
Margin Money Scheme
2211. SHRI SUDARSHAN
AKARAPU: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Khadi and Village
Industries Commission (KVIC) had
launched Margin Money Scheme for
setting up agro based and rural industries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of agro and rural
industries assisted under the scheme during
the last three years, State-wise; and
(d) the total amount sanctioned and
spent under the scheme?
REGP in Tamil Nadu
2212. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up
any agro-rural industries in Tamil Nadu
under Rural Employment Generation
Programme during the last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the fund allocation;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken by Government
to further promote these sectors in
Tamil Nadu?

487
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Cottage industries in Bihar
†2213. SHRIMATI  KUM KUM RAI :
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the cottage industries in the areas belonging
to SCs/STs/most backward classes have to
face host of problems in the State of Bihar;
(b) if so, the steps taken or proposed to
be taken in near future for the promotion
of cottage industries;
(c) the number of small scale industries
in Bihar at present, area-wise;
(d) whether Government have taken any
initiative to boost up the setting up of small
industrial units in the backward and tribal
areas of Bihar; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Industries set up under NPRI
2214. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of rural industrial
clusters set up in the States of Bihar,
Jharkhand, Orissa and Rajasthan under the
National Programme on Rural
Industrialisation (NPRI);
(b) the financial assistance provided to
these States under the said scheme and the
outcome thereof; and
(c) the institutional arrangement made
to implement NPRI in these States?
Funds for Khadi and Village Industries
2215. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the amount of funds earmarked for
research and development for promoting
Khadi and Village Industries (KVI) during
the last three years and the outcome thereof,
State-wise;
(b) whether Government intend to
enhance allocation meant for R&D for
KVI; and
(c) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
Development of coir industries
2216. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Coir Board
has asked for Centre's help for development
of this sector on the lines of Bamboo
industry;
(b) whether it is also a fact that this
industry has immense potential in the
international market; and
(c) if so, the details of the action plan
of Government to develop this industry to
generate additional employment and
improve the economy of this sector?
Selection criteria of BARC Training
School, Mumbai
2217. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA:
SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Engineering Graduates and
Science Post-graduates have been
interviewed this year for selection to
training of OCES and DGFS at BARC
Training School, Mumbai, for appointment
of Scientific Officer 'C';

removal of favouritism through written test
by UPSC instead of interview by BARC;

(d) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
